<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <title>Black circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      circle { fill: CanvasText; }
    }
  </style>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 2 2'%3E%3Ccircle cx='1' cy='1' r='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
      <title id="circle-title">Black circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="#000"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I didn't change `0.html` because it's already in good shape for what it does, which is show a centered black circle. It already handles:

- **Sizing:** it scales with `min(400px, 90vmin)` and uses `100dvh` so mobile browser toolbars don't throw off the centering.
- **Accessibility:** the SVG has `role="img"` and a `<title>` for screen readers, and there's a `forced-colors` rule so the circle still shows in Windows High Contrast mode.
- **Clean markup:** it has a CSS reset, a `<main>` landmark and an inline SVG favicon, so there's no extra request.

The only possible tweaks are tiny, like removing `overflow: visible`, which doesn't do anything here. Changing the file for that would be busywork.

What kind of improvement did you have in mind? For example:
- **Visual:** a gradient, shadow, animation or dark-mode support
- **Interactive:** hover or click effects, or letting the user change the size or color
- **Content:** turning it into a real page with text or navigation
- **Technical:** a canvas version, a pure-CSS version without the SVG, or a smaller file

Tell me the direction and I'll make the change.
